name: vue
summary: Components a template uses without importing them.
note: Quasar and its neighbours auto-import components, so <UserCard /> with
no import beside it still names src/components/UserCard.vue, at
whatever depth the file happens to sit. That is why these candidates
search by basename rather than build an exact path.
The rejected prefixes are components that ship in node_modules. A tag
like <q-btn /> is Quasar's own, and no file in the repository is it.
